description: Single-step read-only investigation. The orchestrator supplies a self-contained brief; a planner agent investigates and writes a findings report.
name: investigate

steps.prompt:
You are running a READ-ONLY investigation. Do not edit code, commit, or restart any server.

Your process cwd is the parent session's primary workspace folder. Use ABSOLUTE paths for every file operation and git command (git -C).

## Investigation brief

{{brief}}

## Output

Write your complete findings report to {{report_path}} (absolute path). Structure: summary answer first, then evidence with file/symbol citations, then conclusions and recommendations. Recommend fixes if relevant but implement nothing.

When finished, call send_message with a 1-2 sentence summary of the key finding.
